source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of crossing over (PDF 102-103).

blocks.text: Gametes bante waqt (meiosis-I mein) homologous chromosomes crossing over se guzarte hain. Yahi amal linked genes ke naye milap (recombination) ka zimmedar hai. Crossing over mein do homologous chromosomes ke chromatids aik doosre ke saath saath qatar mein aa jate hain aur DNA ke hisse aapas mein badal lete hain (swap ya exchange). Is mein DNA strands waqai toot kar dobara jurte hain. Crossing over ke baad homologous chromosomes aik doosre se alag ho jate hain. Jin chromatids mein crossing over hua un par ab bhi wahi genes usi tarteeb mein hote hain, lekin alleles ki tarteeb badal jati hai. Jab yeh recombinant chromatids mukhtalif gametes mein jate hain to gametes mein bohat zyada farq (variety) paida hota hai. Is liye crossing over genes ke naye milap laata hai aur genetic variability (farq) ka zimmedar hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar marahil; har chromatid par genes A, B aur C. 1, Homologous chromosomes: naranji chromosome (do sister chromatids A B C, aik jaise alleles) aur jamni (a b c). 2, Pairing aur segments ka tabadla: andar wale non-sister chromatids (wahi genes, mukhtalif alleles) C aur c wala hissa badalte hain. 3, Homologous jora alag hota hai. 4, Chromatids alag ho kar har aik gamete mein jata hai: A B C aur a b c parental, A B c aur a b C naye milap.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rang dekhein: naranji chromosome aik walid ka aur jamni doosre walid ka hai. Doosre marhale mein sirf andar wale do non-sister chromatids C wala hissa badalte hain. Is liye aakhir mein bahar wale do chromatids purane milap (A B C, a b c) aur andar wale do naye milap (A B c, a b C) le kar gametes mein jate hain.

blocks.title: Do taash ki gaddiyan sochiye
blocks.text: Do taash ki gaddiyan saath saath rakhiye, aik neeli pusht wali aur aik surkh, dono aik hi tarteeb mein. Dono ko aik hi jagah se kaat kar neeche ke aadhe badal dein: har card ki jagah wahi hai, lekin ab har gaddi mein neele aur surkh dono card hain. Crossing over mein genes ki jagah wahi rehti hai, sirf alleles ka milap badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Aik cell ke homologous chromosomes par AB aur ab hain. A aur B ke darmiyan aik crossing over hota hai. Kaun se gametes bante hain?
blocks.explanation: Do parental (AB aur ab) aur do recombinant ya naye (Ab aur aB).

items: Crossing over: meiosis-I mein homologous chromosomes ke non-sister chromatids DNA ke hisse badalte hain.
Genes wahi aur usi tarteeb mein; alleles ke naye milap: linked genes ki recombination aur genetic variability.
